title: A Transparent Fairness Evaluation Protocol for Open-Source Language Model Benchmarking on the Blockchain
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured stereotypical social bias in contextual associations related to religion using metrics derived from the StereoSet dataset, specifically the Idealized Contextual Association Test (ICAT) for Religion.
findings: Using the ICAT Religion metric, where a higher score indicates lower bias (ideal is 100), Llama (70.06) showed the least religious bias, followed by DeepSeek (30.57) and Mistral (16.56). All models exhibited some degree of bias in the religious domain.
